messages.subject: Technical documentation R-Shiny
parts:
I was wondering if there is any technical article / document that describes how R-Shiny works technically. That is, which technologies are used (HTML, CSS, JS, etc.), how they communiate, etc.

I could hardly find any information about the technical realization of Shiny going beyond the package documentation, neither on the website nor on the R-Studio site itself.
